title: Live Vshell C2 operator 'newsakaye' - 4-node HK cluster
bph_link: Netsec Limited (AS45753) - HK host, not currently a tracked BPH entity
summary: A single Vshell C2 operator runs a four-node cluster on Netsec Limited (AS45753, HK), all four Shodan-visible and VirusTotal-flagged as of 2026-09-10, with an exposed MariaDB still on :3306. The nodes share one TLS cert (vshell[.]newsakaye[.]com) and back the same operator tooling domain. Shares the fraud-oriented, HK-hosted, Chinese-C2 profile of the co-reported Gshell activity.

title: Hands-on intrusion / custom C2 with BYOVD EDR evasion on Kaopu Cloud HK
family: Custom Python C2 + BYOVD EDR evasion (hands-on intrusion)
vt: 0 (not externally flagged; verified live via exposure)
summary: A hands-on-keyboard intrusion operation staged on the suspected-BPH host Kaopu Cloud HK (AS138915), still Shodan-visible as of 2026-09-10 (ports 22/80). The host held a custom Python C2 with accumulated live implant state, an MSSQL RCE chain, a Windows privilege-escalation suite, a bring-your-own-vulnerable-driver EDR-evasion kit, and a chisel tunneller. Not flagged by public feeds, so assessed on first-party evidence.

title: Live Gshell C2 nodes on CTG Server (HK), China-nexus fraud
vt: 3-4 malicious per node; 1 communicating sample on a since-offline outlier
summary: Two co-managed Gshell C2 servers (Go-based Chinese framework) remain live on CTG Server (AS152194, HK), verified 2026-09-10 on ports 8080/8089. Co-management is proven by a shared TLS cert serial and a shared SSH host key. The wider cluster first mapped in July (SHANGXING, NTT, SpeedVM, Globenet nodes) has largely gone dark, leaving CTG as the persistent host. Passive DNS ties the nodes to a financially-motivated fraud domain web.

title: Intrusion toolkit / credential-dumping staging on sanctioned FUNNULL (via CTG)
family: Intrusion toolkit staging (credential dumping + masqueraded payload)
provider: FUNNULL Technology Inc. (routes via CTG Server, AS152194)
summary: An intrusion-toolkit staging host on the OFAC-sanctioned bulletproof operator FUNNULL (routing via CTG Server, AS152194) remains live and flagged as of 2026-09-10 (VirusTotal 10, ThreatFox botnet C2, ports 80/7000). It served a credential-dumping utility, an SSH tunneller, and a payload masquerading as a Microsoft Word executable.

title: GPU/AI-host (ComfyUI) cryptojacking run from sanctioned Aeza
summary: An operator on the OFAC-sanctioned bulletproof host Aeza (AS210644) mass-scans internet-exposed AI image-generation (ComfyUI) and other GPU hosts and deploys cryptominers. The staging host is still live and VirusTotal-flagged as of 2026-09-10 (ports 8080/8081 up), holding large scan-result sets, 10+ miner builds, and directories masquerading as system/kubelet components for persistence.

title: Evri parcel-delivery phishing with authoritative DNS on sanctioned Aeza
summary: A parcel-delivery (Evri) phishing domain runs its own authoritative nameservers inside the OFAC-sanctioned bulletproof host Aeza, while serving the phishing page from commodity hosting — using the sanctioned operator for DNS resilience against takedown.

title: DarkSeller carding / fullz marketplace and shadow-services forum
provider: VDSINA (AS216071, ex-Zservers) + GREEN FLOID / REG[.]RU / M247, Cloudflare-fronted
summary: DarkSeller is a live carding / fullz marketplace selling self-registered US bank accounts and SSNs, paired with a Russian-language 'Migalki' shadow-services forum. It is Cloudflare-fronted with backend and DNS spread across commodity and bulletproof-adjacent hosts; no malware/phishing feed flags it.

title: 93 domains self-hosting authoritative DNS inside sanctioned Aeza
summary: A Certificate-Transparency-derived sweep found 93 distinct domains running their own authoritative nameservers inside the OFAC-sanctioned bulletproof host Aeza (AS210644 / AS216246, both verified currently Aeza) — proxy/tunnel, VPN, delivery-phishing and generic-scam themes co-located on the sanctioned operator's DNS, a takedown-resistance pattern.

title: Active Remcos / AgentTesla C2 tied to Aeza staging
summary: A Windows C2 server running Remcos, AgentTesla and a "Taskun" panel, fed by RFQ/quotation malspam. A UAC-bypass ChromeElevator loader staged on Aeza beacons here, linking the Aeza open-directory staging dir to an active info-stealer operation.

title: Unreported NetSupport RAT C2 chain (mheusa04)
summary: A novel, unsubmitted NetSupport Manager RAT dropper staged on Aeza infrastructure delivers a fully unreported C2 chain. Procurement/tender-themed lure; financially-motivated (BEC/fraud/access) tradecraft against corporate finance teams.

title: Nexus C2 panel hosted on BtHoster (since pulled)
summary: An instance of the emerging multi-tenant Nexus C2 framework ran on confirmed BtHoster infrastructure with 40+ communicating Windows implants during an April-May 2026 burst, then was pulled to a maintenance page after public disclosure. Notable for placing a documented C2-as-a-service framework directly on an actively-rotating bulletproof operator.

title: MeshCentral RMM-abuse C2 on Aeza-staged payloads
summary: A MeshCentral C2 reached by MeshAgent and a .NET stub payload both staged in the same Aeza open directory — RMM software repurposed as remote-access C2.
